newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list Guilford, Ranger Oil options.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list Guilford, Ranger Oil options.

text.p: Chicago Board Options Exchange said Wednesday it will list on Nov 20 options on Guilford Pharmaceuticals Inc and Ranger Oil Ltd.
Guilford options will have introductory expirations in December, January, March and June, with opening strike prices of 25, 30 and 35.
Genesis Trading Group LLC will be the designated primary market maker in the options.
For Ranger Oil, initial expirations will be in December, January, April and July. Opening strikes will be at 5, 7-1/2 and 10. The options will trade in the Wal-Mart Stores crowd.
The company is based in Calgary, Alberta, Canada.
